decision_scope: SOURCE_LOCK_ONLY_THE_L03_FOUNDATIONAL_INTERROGATIVE_OPI_SLOT_MODEL_AS_TEN_UNNAMED_POSITIONS_WITH_NONCANONICAL_INTERNAL_INDICES; DO_NOT_CREATE_CANONICAL_SLOT_IDS_OR_LABELS, ASSIGN_CONTENT_TO_POSITIONS, AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

decisions.statement: Source-lock the L03 foundational interrogative OPI cardinality at 10 from the current curriculum manifest.
Treat all ten individual slots as canonically unnamed and identity-unresolved; create no canonical slot IDs or labels.
Permit internal numeric position selectors 1..10 only as NONCANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_INDEX_ONLY references; they are not slot IDs and consume no slots by themselves.
Keep the VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE curriculum-source binding unallocated to any individual position in this gate.
Do not author or validate OPI, unlock QA/STR003-STR005, generalize KE or alter lexical authority.
If approved, open only a separate positional-allocation strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Source-locking the slot model is not individual slot assignment or OPI authoring.
Noncanonical numeric position selectors must never be represented as canonical OPI identifiers without a future explicit authority decision.
No subject/person, tense/aspect or copula semantics are introduced by the slot model.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this slot-model source lock while this gate remains active.
